title: Cartilage methylation QTLs available for download
summary: Cartilage mQTL results from a new study are available for download from the MSK-KP.
bodyHtml: A new epigenome-wide association study of knee cartilage degeneration has just been published, and the authors (Kreitmaier et al.) have shared their results via the MSK-KP! The methylation QTLs that they discovered in high- and low-grade cartilage and in synovium are now available for download.
